reversed_edges.why: A question asks X -> Y but the graph may hold Y -> X. Raw node pairs almost never appear both ways, so the risk is a question written in reverse (gold: no_evidence, reverse edges named in searched_for) and class-level reversal once concepts are merged (re-count after item 3). Roles must be kept.
reversed_edges.handled_by: linker (role-aware pairs), retriever (report reverse edges in searched_for)
